research_methodology_amendment.amendment_name: Sparse-Bar Interpretation, Inexpensive Screening, and Evaluator Compatibility
research_methodology_amendment.supersedes_prior_rule: Supersedes CORR-001 conflation of sparse minutes with missing data, unranked baseline RV handling, full-universe OR querying, and evaluator missing-minute fill assumptions.

practical_principles.principle_a: Work with real-world data availability. Ordinary missing historical intervals or legitimate no-trade intervals must not invalidate an otherwise representative study. Provider data failures must be distinguished from legitimate no-trade/no-setup market conditions.
practical_principles.principle_b: Retain externally supported ORB strategy as a permanent research candidate regardless of independent evaluation outcomes.

sparse_bar_opening_range_semantics.rule: 1 to 5 valid minute bars in 09:30-09:34 ET construct valid opening range (Open=first bar open, High=max high, Low=min low, Close=last bar close, Volume=sum volume). Zero bars received -> valid resolved outcome NO_OPENING_PRINT_NO_SETUP. Corrupt, non-finite, out-of-order, or duplicate minute timestamps fail closed.

relative_volume_baseline_semantics.rule: 14 prior session opening ranges aggregate volume from valid sparse bars. If all 14 prior sessions traded zero volume, mean_prior is 0.0, RV is uncomputable, yielding valid resolved outcome UNRANKABLE_ZERO_RV_BASELINE. A genuinely missing trading session fails closed as PROVIDER_DATA_FAILURE.

stage_b_price_path_semantics.rule: Sparse minute bars during 09:35-15:59 ET represent absence of trade prints. Pending orders remain pending; open positions remain open; missing 15:59 EOD bar for an open position strictly fails closed as non_computable.

operational_query_ordering.rule: Execute broad daily screening (ADV14 >= 1M, ATR14 > $0.50) on Dec 2023 D-1 history first. Next screen current opening range (09:30-09:34) and price > $5.00 for daily-base-qualified symbols. Prior 14 OR sessions are queried only for surviving daily-base-qualified symbols with current OR open > $5.00.

candidate_screening_gate.interpretation: Evaluates candidate-screening completeness among daily-base-qualified symbols. Legitimate no-trade outcomes (NO_OPENING_PRINT_NO_SETUP, UNRANKABLE_ZERO_RV_BASELINE) count as validly determined. Provider errors, HTTP failures, and malformed bars count against completeness.

operational_safety_bounds.action_on_exceed: STOP before execution and report BLOCKED_RESOURCE_BOUND

pilot_scope.massive_snapshot: ONE complete 2024-01-02 snapshot (active=true, market=stocks, locale=us, terminal pagination required)
